t: Kilometers Per Minute (km/m) - Speed / Velocity Conversions
s: Kilometers per minute is a unit of speed in the Metric System. It measures the number of kilometers traveled in a minute. The symbol for kilometers per minute is km/m and the International spelling for this unit is kilometres per minute.
